Fix round OR-112-19 (client purchases secret) — head 32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9 (B-SECRETS-2, agent 112, builder)

**Mobile grep first** (growth-project-mobile origin/main f34b5b99, `git grep` over src/): no code reads a client secret, ephemeral key or any `*_secret` from a purchase row. `ClientPurchase` (`src/api/clientPaymentsApi.ts`) types only `id, package_id, status, entitlement_active, access_expires_at, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, created_at`; `getPurchases` / `getPaymentStatus` / `PurchaseUnpackScreen.buildReceipt` read only those. Client secrets are read only from mint responses (`POST /v1/checkout/sessions` in `PackageSelectionSheet.tsx`; `CheckoutSessionResponse` in `packagesApi.ts`). Mobile does not call `GET /v1/coach/purchases`. There is no client `GET /v1/checkout/purchases/:id`.

**Ruling applied:** mobile never reads it, so the secret is dropped from the client purchase list for every status (including a purchase still awaiting client action). A payment that needs client action resumes through `POST /v1/checkout/payment-intent` with the same idempotency key, which replays the cached secret to its owner only (unchanged).

**What changed (32f7ede4)**
- `src/checkout/client-purchases.select.ts` (new): `CLIENT_PURCHASE_SELECT` explicit allow-list + `ClientPurchaseView`. Keeps every mobile-read field plus amount, currency, billing_type, last_error, source, client/coach ids, updated_at. Drops `stripe_client_secret`, `stripe_ephemeral_key`, `idempotency_key`, `stripe_checkout_session_id`, `stripe_payment_intent_id`, `stripe_subscription_id`, `stripe_customer_id`, `stripe_destination_account`, `grant_metadata`, `landing_page_id`, `contract_envelope_id`.
- `CheckoutService.listForClient` (`GET /v1/checkout/purchases`) selects it.
- Found while checking: `CheckoutService.listForCoach` (`GET /v1/coach/purchases`, `CoachPurchasesController`) returned raw rows to coaches, the same C-641-2 leak this PR closes on `/v1/coach/payments`. It now selects `COACH_PURCHASE_SELECT` (`CoachPurchaseView` exported).
- Other client purchase reads checked, already shaped: `/purchases/:id/drops` (select `{ id }`), `/sessions/:id/confirm`, `claim-free` / `claim-grant`, public thank-you page.

**Failing-before evidence:** `test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts` drives the real `CheckoutController.listPurchases` and `CoachPurchasesController.list` over the real `CheckoutService` with a Prisma double that returns the full stored row when no `select` is given. On ea919f6b (spec + new select file, service unchanged): 3 failed / 3 passed — the client list, client pagination and coach feed responses contained `stripe_client_secret: "pi_3SETTLED_secret_..."`, `stripe_ephemeral_key`, `idempotency_key`, Stripe ids and grant metadata. After 32f7ede4: 6/6 pass.

**Local (targeted, through heavy.sh):** `npx jest --runInBand test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts test/checkout.service.spec.ts test/checkout-buyer-drops.spec.ts test/payment-ops.controller.spec.ts test/packages.service.spec.ts test/dunning-v2-lockout-allowlist-route-table.spec.ts` → 7 suites, 207 tests passed. Scoped strict `tsc --noEmit` over the touched files: clean. eslint on changed files: clean. `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=staged`: no positive token change. Prettier clean on new files (the pre-existing format drift in checkout.service.ts is untouched).

PR body updated (tier T4 unchanged, fix-round row added) and retitled. Main not merged (PR is MERGEABLE). Needs an independent audit at this head.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#646 @ 32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9 — VERDICT: APPROVE

Independent first Sol T4 audit; **A/B/C 0/0/2**, with no remaining mandatory defect found in the changed coach/client-list boundary. I read the full seven-file diff, the original C-641-2, the extension/fix-round contract, all #646 comments and mobile main `f34b5b99e1f1b20c1764def9749e08a4e3483f96`; I did not implement this change. [Candidate/fix-round contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/646#issuecomment-5961705101), [original scoped finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/641).

### Closed secret boundary

**C-641-2 and OR-112-19 close on their stated surfaces:** explicit Prisma selects now omit cached PaymentIntent client secrets, ephemeral keys, internal request keys, connected-account identifiers and grant metadata from coach purchases/list/detail/failed, earnings, package subscribers, the older coach purchase feed and the client's purchase list, for pending and settled purchases alike. Nested detail/failed ledger, transfer and dunning reads are allow-listed, not raw relation includes; future columns stay private by default, and existing ownership predicates/order/pagination remain intact. [Allow-lists](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/checkout/coach-payments.select.ts), [client select](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/checkout/client-purchases.select.ts), [controller reads](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/checkout/payment-ops.controller.ts#L647-L895), [subscriber read](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/packages/packages.service.ts#L510-L539).

Mobile main does not read either removed cached secret from a purchase row; its nine purchase-list fields and the earnings fields it consumes are retained. Legitimate owner-bound payment-intent mint/replay remains separate and still returns its caller's PaymentSheet credential; there is no client purchase-detail route returning a raw row, and confirmation, buyer drops, free/grant claims and public thank-you use shaped results. [Mobile purchase contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f34b5b99e1f1b20c1764def9749e08a4e3483f96/src/api/clientPaymentsApi.ts#L129-L158), [mobile earnings adapter](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f34b5b99e1f1b20c1764def9749e08a4e3483f96/src/api/packagesApi.ts), [same-owner replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L503-L520), [replay regression](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts#L297-L315).

The inspected Stripe webhook path returns a processed acknowledgement, not the Stripe event/object; other raw purchase reads found in package delivery, reconciliation and entitlement remain internal/shaped rather than another unprotected coach response. This is a scoped source review, not a claim that all historic logs or production payloads have been inventoried. [Webhook response, src/billing/billing.service.ts:676](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/billing/billing.service.ts#L676), [internal package reads](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/packages/package-push.service.ts), [entitlement and card shaping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L959-L1022).

### Optional hardening, explicitly outside the changed access boundary

- **C-646-1:** the unchanged administrative list/detail and dunning override view still serialize raw ClientPurchase rows, including cached client secrets. These routes are separately owner-only, with JwtAuthGuard + ServiceTokenGuard + RolesGuard; I found no ordinary-coach route into them, so this is not a reclassification of the fixed coach leak. Apply an admin-safe allow-list too unless a separately approved operation genuinely requires a client's payment credential, and add an admin serializer regression. [Owner-only controller and raw serializers, src/checkout/payment-ops.controller.ts:110–203](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/checkout/payment-ops.controller.ts#L110-L203), [raw dunning view, src/checkout/dunning.service.ts:685–699](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/checkout/dunning.service.ts#L685-L699).
- **C-646-2:** the unchanged generic log redactor recognizes `client_secret` and `secret` but not the stored names `stripe_client_secret` / `stripe_ephemeral_key` (nor all `*_secret` variants). No newly changed route logs these rows, and I do not assert an observed credential emission; add these exact names/patterns to structured and string redaction with nested/serialized canary tests as defense in depth. [Exact-key redaction and string pattern, src/observability/log-redaction.ts:24–121](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/src/observability/log-redaction.ts#L24-L121).

### Execution, tier header and gates

Independent private Prisma generation passed; `ops/heavy.sh env CI=false npx jest --runInBand --forceExit --runTestsByPath test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts test/checkout.service.spec.ts test/checkout-buyer-drops.spec.ts test/payment-ops.controller.spec.ts test/packages.service.spec.ts` passed **6 suites / 171 tests**, exit 0. The new tests drive real service/controller methods over a select-aware Prisma double that otherwise returns full planted-secret rows and recursively check keys/values; owner-detail, pagination, pending/canceled/grant rows, preserved mobile fields and legitimate replay are covered. [Coach acceptance tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts), [client/feed acceptance tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9/test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts).

All ten required checks, including Schema parity, are SUCCESS at the guarded exact head; actual build CI passed **658 suites / 11,366 tests**, with **20 suites / 209 tests skipped and five todo**. `git diff --check` passes, and there is no dependency, schema, migration, environment or trusted-gate change; the PR header correctly remains T4 and its extension fix-round table is present. No local full suite/tsc, real Stripe/DB/provider call, source push, merge, dispatch or production action was performed. [Executed build](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37066451115/job/111035311524), [exact-head checks and body](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/646).

### Outside this diff / mobile compatibility qualification

The PR body overstates that package subscribers are “not consumed”: mobile main already calls that route, but expects a different reporting shape that neither the old raw rows nor these safe projections implement. None of the newly removed fields satisfies that existing UI contract, so this is an inherited integration/release issue, not grounds to restore secrets or block this security narrowing; route subscriber reporting separately and correct the body description. Evidence is retained under `ops/evidence/AUD-SOL-6-112/`, and this approval does not certify subscriber-screen or native checkout acceptance. [Existing mobile caller/shape](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f34b5b99e1f1b20c1764def9749e08a4e3483f96/src/api/packagesApi.ts#L88-L104), [caller implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f34b5b99e1f1b20c1764def9749e08a4e3483f96/src/screens/coach/payments/CoachPackageSubscribersScreen.tsx).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#646 @ 32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9 — VERDICT: APPROVE

First audit by this lens. T4 (payment credentials). A/B/C: 0/0/2. Range read: 3bd6215b..32f7ede4 (ea919f6b C-641-2, 32f7ede4 OR-112-19), all 7 files.

**What I checked**
- Every coach-facing purchase read now uses an explicit allow-list: `/v1/coach/payments/purchases`, `/purchases/:id` (purchase + ledger + transfers + dunning), `/failed` (old `include: { dunning: true }` replaced by a nested select), `/earnings`, `/v1/coach/packages/:id/subscribers`, and `/v1/coach/purchases` (`CheckoutService.listForCoach`). The client's `/v1/checkout/purchases` (`listForClient`) uses `CLIENT_PURCHASE_SELECT`. None of the allow-lists names `stripe_client_secret`, `stripe_ephemeral_key`, `idempotency_key`, `stripe_customer_id`, `stripe_destination_account`, `payee_stripe_account_id`, `stripe_application_fee_id` or `grant_metadata` (checked against prisma/schema.prisma `ClientPurchase`, `SplitLedgerEntry`, `ConnectTransfer`, `DunningState`).
- Hunt for other leak paths at the head. Every `clientPurchase.find*/create/update/upsert` in src (94 call sites) whose result can reach a response; every `include:` of a purchase relation; raw SQL on `"ClientPurchase"` (coach-brief: aggregates only); invite-grant (shaped `{purchase_id,status}` / `{revoked,purchase_ids}`); confirm, thank-you, drops, admin-analytics coach summary (aggregates only); earnings CSV (fixed columns); Stripe webhook controller (returns `{processed,...}` only); logger and Sentry calls in checkout/connect/invite-grant/packages (no row objects interpolated); data export (no purchase rows). Coach routes: no remaining leak. Owner-only routes: see C-646-1.
- Nothing a client needs is broken. The `POST /v1/checkout/payment-intent` replay (`pi-${client.id}-${key}`, `existing.client_user_id === client.id`) is unchanged and still returns the cached secret to its owner only (spec "resume path"). On mobile main f34b5b99 and open PRs #321/#322/#329/#332, nothing reads a removed field: `ClientPurchase` in clientPaymentsApi.ts types only kept fields, `BackendEarningsResponse.entries` fields are all in `COACH_LEDGER_SELECT`, `/subscribers` is not consumed yet.
- Test honesty. The Prisma doubles return the FULL row when there is no `select`. I put the base `checkout.service.ts`, `payment-ops.controller.ts` and `packages.service.ts` back in place and ran both new specs: 8 failed / 4 passed (3 client-list + 5 coach routes fail before the fix). With the fix: `heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts test/payment-ops.controller.spec.ts test/packages.service.spec.ts`: 4 suites, 137 passed.
- Required checks at 32f7ede4: build-and-test, rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, npm audit, CodeQL (+ JS/TS), Banned cast tokens, build-sbom, danger, Schema parity: all success. The branch is BEHIND main c8e5e71f, and `git merge-tree` against main is clean.
- Tier header: present and current (Tier T4 / Why / T4 + T3 scans / Bounded T1 / Builder-owner / Acceptance evidence / Promotion triggers). The fix-round table covers C-641-2 and OR-112-19.

**Findings**
- **C-646-1 (optional, defense in depth): owner admin routes still return raw rows with the client's secrets.** `src/checkout/payment-ops.controller.ts:145-154` (`GET /v1/admin/payments/purchases`, raw `findMany`) and `:165-168` (`GET /v1/admin/payments/purchases/:id`, `include: { package: true }`) send `stripe_client_secret` and `stripe_ephemeral_key` to the owner console (SSR, JWT + ADMIN_SERVICE_TOKEN). The owner already holds the Stripe secret key, so this gives no new access. It does put live customer payment credentials into console responses and server logs. Minimal fix: an `ADMIN_PURCHASE_SELECT` (every column except the two secrets) on those two reads. Keep the Stripe ids for support.
- **C-646-2 (optional): cached secrets are never cleared.** `checkout.service.ts:673-681` stores `stripe_client_secret` / `stripe_ephemeral_key` and nothing ever nulls them, even after the PaymentIntent is terminal (paid / canceled / refunded). Clearing both columns in the `payment_intent.succeeded` / `canceled` webhook transitions shrinks the at-rest exposure of any future raw read to zero. Replay only matters while the purchase is `pending`.

**Outside this diff (operator attention, launch risk; not a #646 finding)**
- Mobile `src/components/PackageSelectionSheet.tsx:288-301` (main f34b5b99, unchanged in every open mobile PR) POSTs `{ package_id, idempotency_key }` to `/v1/checkout/sessions`. Backend `CreateCheckoutDto` (`checkout.controller.ts:44-64`) has no `idempotency_key`, and `main.ts:99-100` sets `forbidNonWhitelisted: true`, so this returns 400. Even a valid call returns `{ session_id, url, purchase_id, status, package }`, not `stripe_client_secret` / `stripe_ephemeral_key`, and `initPaymentSheet` gets no `customerId`. The Day 1 / RootNavigator package sheet therefore cannot take a payment and shows the generic "Payment failed. Please try again." The PR body's statement that mobile reads secrets from the `/v1/checkout/sessions` mint is inaccurate. Mobile never calls `POST /v1/checkout/payment-intent`, the route that returns `client_secret`, `ephemeral_key`, `customer_id` and `publishable_key`. Recommended default: a mobile slice switches the sheet to `/v1/checkout/payment-intent`, passes `customerId`, and maps 409 COACH_NOT_CONNECTED / COACH_NOT_PAYOUT_READY / 503 PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS / PAYMENT_RETRY to specific copy.
- #627 (open) touches the same three source files (checkout.service.ts, payment-ops.controller.ts, packages.service.ts). Whichever merges second must keep the allow-lists. Any new coach-facing purchase or ledger read in #627 should use `COACH_*_SELECT`.
